headline: Accounts Payable and Purchasing Officer
skills: Price and terms negotiation with suppliers
Document control for purchase and payment files
summary: Accounts payable and purchasing officer with four years at a copper mining contractor. I process supplier invoices from purchase request to payment, prepare purchase orders, and negotiate prices and delivery terms with local suppliers. I keep payment files complete so audits run smoothly.

experience.title: Accounts Payable and Purchasing Officer
bullets: Match about 600 supplier invoices a month to purchase orders and receiving reports before payment.
Canvass at least three suppliers for each request and issue purchase orders for parts, fuel and safety gear.
Negotiated annual prices with two tyre suppliers, saving roughly 8% on the year's spend.
Keep purchase and payment files organised so auditors can trace any payment in minutes.

experience.title: Accounting Clerk
bullets: Recorded supplier bills and prepared checks and vouchers for approval.
Maintained the supplier master list and chased missing invoices.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Management Accounting
